design.question: Can either registered non-distinguisher satisfy the CE2 criterion?
design.why: Battery v2 tested A3 against CE3 and A4 against CE4 and registered CE2 as untested. Under CE Rule III a CE test establishes a cryptographic interpretation only if it has greater explanatory power than the remaining alternatives; a criterion that a constructed non-distinguisher satisfies cannot. This experiment decides whether CE2 can carry a claim to L3.

A3.construction: frozen constant-output model, audit/adversarial/evidence/a3_20261006: the artifact must match the freeze manifest's model SHA-256 and recorded freeze commit. battery.py and sealed_sets.py have changed since the freeze (see the A3 ERRATUM); that check is recorded in the certificate and not enforced, because E6 interprets A3 only through the frozen ce234 CE2 routine and not through the battery's own evaluation code.
A3.rationale: A constant output has no rank correlation with any target; the frozen run_ce2 excludes such runs, so fewer than the minimum 20 valid runs remain and the frozen rule returns INCONCLUSIVE.

A4.construction: battery.A4XorResponse with key ciphermind-A4-xor-response-v1; construction VALID per audit/adversarial/evidence/a4_20261006/a4_certificate.json (AUC 0.4999)
A4.rationale: The output depends on the input only through the ciphertext-pair XOR, via a keyed hash with no order structure, so its rank correlation with the single-trail probability is expected to be near zero; development screening (screening.py, not evidence) measured Spearman -0.003.

design.procedure: Each adversary is passed as `model` to the frozen audit.cryptography.ce234.production.run_ce2; the frozen analyse_ce2 decides. CE2 is not re-implemented and no frozen file is modified.
design.adversarial_outcome_rule: CE2_CRITERION_SATISFIED iff the frozen CE2 decision is SUPPORTED; otherwise CE2_CRITERION_NOT_SATISFIED

interpretation.if_none_satisfied: Neither registered non-distinguisher satisfies CE2. CE2 is admitted as a test that can establish L3 under the admission condition; this is not a proof that no other non-distinguisher could satisfy it.
interpretation.if_any_satisfied: A registered non-distinguisher satisfies CE2. CE2 is corroborating only and cannot establish L3.

design.verification: e6_verification.json recomputes every primary rho from the raw files and re-applies analyse_ce2; any mismatch makes the certificate NOT_VERIFIED.
design.environment_requirement: the CE2 production environment: Python 3.11, TensorFlow 2.21, Keras 3, numpy 2.x, scipy 1.17, CPU
not_claimed: that CE2 cannot be satisfied by any non-distinguisher
anything about CE3 or CE4, whose adversarial results stand as registered in battery v2
